design.holdout_policy: Refit the tuning winner on train+tune; evaluate once on holdout. Never choose or change parameters from holdout.
design.production_policy: Refit the already selected algorithm on all complete targets paired to the 59 preproduction origins and available by 2026-01-31T18:00:00Z.
